approval_scope: One Tev1-4B MPS BF16 batch-4 variant, bound to the existing DMS-20 corpus, exact model revision, runtime, runner, and resource floors.

protocol.input_policy: Use the original approved DMS-20 content limit of 3584 tokenizer tokens and reserve 512 tokens for model-specific formatting. Count with each candidate tokenizer; fail closed without truncation.
protocol.paired_bootstrap_strata: source category; identical item IDs across candidates
protocol.primary_metric: equal macro average of accuracy across the seven included source categories
protocol.probability_metrics: raw Brier and top-label ECE; no calibration fitting
protocol.sensitivity_order: reverse all options while preserving option IDs and gold labels

result_policy: Comparative local research only; preserve the baseline and prior evaluations.

rows.artifact_hash_source: SHA-256 file records for this exact immutable Hub revision published by localai-org/vllm.cpp/docs/models/tev1.md; reverify the downloaded bytes before inference

base_model.training_revision_note: Together does not publish the exact training base revision. The released Tev1 checkpoint is full merged BF16, so the execution does not load a separate base.

rows.license_note: Publisher says the fine-tuned weight license is still being finalized. The user separately confirmed permission for local research use in this conversation; this approval does not grant redistribution, commercial, or production rights.

source.id: togethercomputer/tev1 model card and prompt contract

rows.task_mapping: Map each request to the publisher's state/question/2-24 labeled options JSON contract. Assign A-X in current option order and map the selected letter back to the original option ID. Score candidate next-token letter logits with softmax restricted to current options; no calibration is fitted.
rows.training_provenance: Publisher describes a full fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B but does not publish a pinned training-base revision; this run uses the released full checkpoint, not a claim to reproduce its training pairing.
rows.variant: MPS BF16 microbatch of four independent decision prompts
